description: Extensive settlement (vicus) associated with the Roman fort of Maryport. In the field north east to the fort, at its highest point a rectangular and circular building were identified, along with associated burials and a funeral pyre. Two shrines were also found nearby in 1880. These two buildings are generally accepted to be temples.
